description: What the seam suite must notice between the MCP client manager and the agent (lib/manager.mjs, lib/assemble.mjs, lib/mcp/server-config.mjs, lib/agent.mjs, lib/concurrent-api-agent.mjs, lib/browser-runner.mjs): the catalog, the external route, the owner's policy at the gate, the shared client manager, the instruction cap and the checkpoint rule. A mutant that makes the gate ask where the suite expects no question ends by the runner's timeout.

mutations.name: S1-catalog-without-external
mutations.what: internalCatalog() leaves out the approved servers

mutations.name: S2-no-server-capabilities
mutations.what: an external server is listed with no capabilities

mutations.name: S3-no-prompts
mutations.what: the prompts of an external server are not in the catalog

mutations.name: S4-no-external-route
mutations.what: a call to an external tool never reaches the client manager

patches.old: return await mcp.callTool(parts.server, parts.tool, args ?? {}, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: options.timeout });

mutations.name: S5-no-prompt-route
mutations.what: a prompt of an external server cannot be read

patches.old: return await mcp.getPrompt(server, name, args, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: options.timeout });

mutations.name: S6-refusal-thrown
mutations.what: a call the server never received (quarantined) stops the task as a transport failure

mutations.name: S7-protocol-error-thrown
mutations.what: a JSON-RPC error answer stops the task as a transport failure

mutations.name: S8-transport-failure-swallowed
mutations.what: a lost connection is handed to the model as an error result and the task goes on

mutations.name: S9-no-checkpoint-for-flagged-server
mutations.what: no checkpoint before a call to a server flagged touchesWorkspace

mutations.name: S10-checkpoint-for-every-external
mutations.what: a checkpoint before every external call, flagged or not

mutations.name: S11-policy-not-attached
mutations.what: the gate never hears the owner's policy (every external call asks)

mutations.name: S12-annotations-never-trusted
mutations.what: trust.annotations is not passed to the gate

mutations.name: S13-card-without-server
mutations.what: the approval card does not say how the server is reached

mutations.name: S14-tool-rule-ignored
mutations.what: a per-tool rule (allow, deny) is not read

mutations.name: S15-server-default-ignored
mutations.what: a server's default rule is not read

mutations.name: S16-child-own-client
mutations.what: a spawn_agent child gets a client manager of its own (no server configured in its folder)

mutations.name: S17-web-session-own-client
mutations.what: a web session on another workspace gets a client manager of its own

mutations.name: S18-no-name-cap
mutations.what: the instructions list every tool name

mutations.name: S19-largest-server-first
mutations.what: the cap fills with the largest server before the small ones

mutations.name: S20-auto-mode-drops-external
mutations.what: the auto tool selection drops external tools, so a spawn_agent child is not told of them

mutations.name: S21-no-cap-without-direct-tools
mutations.what: the instructions without direct tools list every name

mutations.name: S22-proof-skips-flagged-server
mutations.what: the proof ledger does not scan a call to a server flagged touchesWorkspace

mutations.name: S23-proof-scans-every-external
mutations.what: the proof ledger scans every external call, flagged or not
